method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the tax-and-benefits brief of 24 October 2026; a seat-neutral core (colc-concessions.l4, colc-levy.l4, colc-vehicles.l4, with shared nouns in colc-common.l4) holding 8 regulative rules, and a seat layer (colc-seat.l4, 26 exported questions) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a financial year before 2024/25 for the concession, any year but 2024/25 for the levy remissions, non-residential or Crown land, or a vehicle meeting more than one of ss 38-38B answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: All six texts are the Open Australian Legal Corpus (v7.1.0, CC BY 4.0) texts, each as at the corpus scrape and possibly out of date: Cost of Living Concessions Act 1986 as at 2015-07-01 (../../registers/source-bundle/cost-of-living-concessions-act-1986.txt); Cost of Living Concessions Regulations 2020 as at 2025-01-01 (../../../cost-of-living-concessions-regulations-2020/registers/source-bundle/cost-of-living-concessions-regulations-2020.txt); Emergency Services Funding Act 1998 as at 2023-11-25, a later version (4.12.2025) listed (../../../emergency-services-funding-act-1998/registers/source-bundle/emergency-services-funding-act-1998.txt); Emergency Services Funding (Remissions--Land) Regulations 2014 as at 2024-07-01 (../../../emergency-services-funding-remissions-land-regulations-2014/registers/source-bundle/emergency-services-funding-remissions-land-regulations-2014.txt; reg 7(1a) and 7(2) formulas missing, see its .formulas.md); Motor Vehicles Act 1959 as at 2024-11-07 (../../../motor-vehicles-act-1959/registers/source-bundle/motor-vehicles-act-1959.txt); Motor Vehicles Regulations 2010 as at 2025-02-20 (../../../motor-vehicles-regulations-2010/registers/source-bundle/motor-vehicles-regulations-2010.txt). Inputs: Adelaide CPI and previous-year amounts (reg 3(3)-(4)), the Minister's low income amounts, the reg 7(1a) and 7(2) levy remission amounts, the levy, the prescribed registration fee, and the days where a text sets none.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is State of South Australia, CC BY 4.0, sourced from the South Australian Legislation website at 10 March 2025 through the Open Australian Legal Corpus (CC BY 4.0); see SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.result: 270 assertions written, 270 satisfied (109 concessions, 48 levy, 48 vehicles, 65 seat), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24, after the corrections recorded as findings 22-25 in NOTES.md); 9 #TRACEs with an expect line (5 breaches, 4 obligations pending), each read and as expected; control copies with expected values altered failed as they should
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the concession holder. Cost of Living Concessions Act 1986: s 2(1)-(3), s 3, s 4(1), (3), s 7, s 8(2)-(4) (regulative). Regulations 2020: reg 3(1)-(4) (prescribed card, prescribed payments, low income earner, relevant asylum seeker, water rates, prescribed capacity, CPI indexation and its floor), reg 4, reg 5 (water rates remission), reg 6, reg 7 (apply before 31 December, regulative; account details; one payment per premises; the Minister's split; Switch for Solar), reg 8. Emergency Services Funding Act 1998: s 3(1) owner (paras (a), (e), (f)), s 15(1)-(2), s 16 (pay by the notice's date, regulative). Remissions--Land Regulations 2014: reg 3, 5A, 6, 7(1a) and 7(2) (inputs), 7(3), 8; 2024/2025 only. Motor Vehicles Act 1959: ss 37A, 38, 38A, 38AB, 38B (with subsections (2) and (3); s 38A(3) regulative), 40 (regulative permission), 40A; s 9(1) only as the consequence of a void registration. Motor Vehicles Regulations 2010: reg 76(4)-(5), reg 77(3)-(4), Schedule 1 cl 1 and cl 22(1)-(5), (7) (cl 22(3) regulative). Out: COLC Act ss 5, 6, 8(1), 9; levy on non-residential land and regs 5, 8A-20; ESF Act s 3(1)(b)-(d), s 5(10), s 15(3)-(6) (subsequent owners), levy declaration, assessment, refunds, interest, penalty levy and collection; all other registration and licence fees and the fee scales; MV Act ss 34, 37 (except as another provision), 41, 42, Part 4; cl 22(6). Read with the Commonwealth Social Security Act 1991, Veterans' Entitlements Act 1986 and Military Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2004 encodings for the cards and payments; cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the concession holder: a holder of a Commonwealth concession card, a recipient of a listed Commonwealth payment, or a low income earner, who owns or rents a home or owns a car
